answer: Bulk fakes are blocked as sponsorship grows dearer with each vouch, starting from a kernel of sponsors who alone may vouch. A newcomer joins only with an anchor from one sponsor, a bond locked until epoch close and lost if the newcomer proves fake. The kth anchor costs k squared credits, so the 10th costs 100 and the 100th costs 10000. The named failure is vouch farming: a rented sponsor still climbs the same ladder, and a ferrous bond cannot be reused. An honest agent needs one 1-credit anchor; 1000 fakes cost about 333 million credits.
